description: Source code for AV1 video decoder delegate using VAAPI in Chromium, handling picture creation, submission, and related VAAPI buffer management.

classes.name: AV1VaapiVideoDecoderDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for AV1 decoding using VAAPI, managing picture creation, submission, and VAAPI buffer lifecycle.

classes.name: VaapiAV1Picture
classes.description: Represents an AV1 picture with associated VA surfaces for display and reconstruction.

methods.name: CreateAV1Picture
methods.description: Creates a new AV1 picture with VA surfaces, optionally applying film grain.

methods.name: OutputPicture
methods.description: Outputs a decoded AV1 picture by signaling surface readiness.

methods.name: SubmitDecode
methods.description: Prepares and submits AV1 decoding buffers to VAAPI, handling decryption, buffer creation, and execution.

methods.name: OnVAContextDestructionSoon
methods.description: Cleans up VAAPI buffers before VA context destruction.
